"use client";
import {useSyncExternalStore} from "react";
import {fuenteDemo} from "@/lib/data/demo";
import {ProveedorDemo} from "@/lib/data/provider";
import {PanelUIProvider} from "@/components/panel/ui";
import {ToastProvider} from "@/components/toast";
import {ProveedorToast} from "@/components/ui";
import {VistaCatalogo} from "@/components/catalogo/vista-catalogo";
import {ErrorClaro} from "@/lib/data/errores";
const leer=fuenteDemo.avisosPendientes,marcar=fuenteDemo.marcarAvisado;
const w=()=>window as typeof window & {__leerFalla?:boolean;__marcarFalla?:boolean;__lecturas?:number;__marcas?:number};
fuenteDemo.avisosPendientes=async(...args)=>{w().__lecturas=(w().__lecturas??0)+1;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));if(w().__leerFalla)throw new ErrorClaro("No pudimos leer quiénes esperan.");return leer(...args);};
fuenteDemo.marcarAvisado=async(...args)=>{w().__marcas=(w().__marcas??0)+1;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));if(w().__marcarFalla)throw new ErrorClaro("No pudimos marcar el aviso.");return marcar(...args);};
const subscribe=()=>()=>{};
export default function Fixture(){const ready=useSyncExternalStore(subscribe,()=>true,()=>false);if(!ready)return null;return <ToastProvider><ProveedorToast><ProveedorDemo cargando={null}><PanelUIProvider><VistaCatalogo/></PanelUIProvider></ProveedorDemo></ProveedorToast></ToastProvider>}
